# harness_platform_login_settings (Resource)

Resource for managing the login settings of a Harness account (password strength policy, user lockout policy and password expiration policy). Destroying this resource resets the policies to the Harness defaults.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage the login settings of a Harness account.
# This is a singleton resource: one instance per Harness account.
resource "harness_platform_login_settings" "example" {
  password_strength_policy {
    enabled                            = true
    min_number_of_characters           = 12
    min_number_of_uppercase_characters = 1
    min_number_of_lowercase_characters = 1
    min_number_of_special_characters   = 1
    min_number_of_digits               = 1
  }

  user_lockout_policy {
    enable_lockout_policy                    = true
    number_of_failed_attempts_before_lockout = 5
    lockout_period                           = 24
    notify_user                              = true
  }

  password_expiration_policy {
    enabled                                        = true
    days_before_password_expires                   = 90
    days_before_user_notified_of_password_expiration = 5
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `password_expiration_policy` (Block List, Max: 1) Password expiration policy of the account. If omitted, the existing policy is left untouched and its current values are readable from state (same behavior as the UI). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--password_expiration_policy))
- `password_strength_policy` (Block List, Max: 1) Password strength policy of the account. If omitted, the existing policy is left untouched and its current values are readable from state (same behavior as the UI). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--password_strength_policy))
- `user_lockout_policy` (Block List, Max: 1) User lockout policy of the account. If omitted, the existing policy is left untouched and its current values are readable from state (same behavior as the UI). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--user_lockout_policy))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--password_expiration_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `password_expiration_policy`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the password expiration policy is enabled.

Optional:

- `days_before_password_expires` (Number) Number of days before a password expires.
- `days_before_user_notified_of_password_expiration` (Number) Number of days before expiration the user is notified.


<a id="nestedblock--password_strength_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `password_strength_policy`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the password strength policy is enabled.

Optional:

- `min_number_of_characters` (Number) Minimum number of characters required in a password.
- `min_number_of_digits` (Number) Minimum number of digits required in a password.
- `min_number_of_lowercase_characters` (Number) Minimum number of lowercase characters required in a password.
- `min_number_of_special_characters` (Number) Minimum number of special characters required in a password.
- `min_number_of_uppercase_characters` (Number) Minimum number of uppercase characters required in a password.


<a id="nestedblock--user_lockout_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_lockout_policy`

Required:

- `enable_lockout_policy` (Boolean) Whether the lockout policy is enabled.

Optional:

- `lockout_period` (Number) Lockout period in hours.
- `notify_user` (Boolean) Whether the user is notified about the lockout.
- `number_of_failed_attempts_before_lockout` (Number) Number of failed login attempts before a user is locked out.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the login settings using the account id
terraform import harness_platform_login_settings.example <account_id>
```
